title: Acupuncture Combined with Exercise Therapy for Sarcopenia in the Elderly
author: Li, Lu, et al.

steps.title: Patient positioning and site disinfection
steps.instruction: Place the patient in the supine position with elbows bent and rested on the chest; the acupuncturist thoroughly disinfects hands and then cleans each selected acupoint with 75 % medical alcohol.

steps.title: Acupuncture needle insertion
steps.instruction: Using a 0.30 mm × 40 mm sterile needle, insert at each bilateral acupoint (ST36, KI3, SP6, LI11, LI4) to a depth of 20–30 mm and apply the tonifying needling technique until the De‑qi sensation is obtained.

steps.title: Needle retention and manipulation
steps.instruction: Retain the needles for 30 minutes, performing reinforcing lifting‑thrusting and twirling manipulations every 10 minutes; after the 30‑minute period, remove all needles.

steps.title: Exercise therapy preparation
steps.instruction: Select a Thera‑band elastic band of teal, yellow, or red resistance (suitable for the elderly); have the patient seated and ready for a 10‑minute warm‑up before resistance training.

steps.title: Perform seated elastic‑band exercises
steps.instruction: Under doctor supervision, the patient completes the following movements, each 3 sets of 10 repetitions with a 1‑minute rest between sets:

substeps.instruction: Seated Elastic Band Chest Expansion (targets triceps brachii and deltoid).
Seated Elastic Band Chest Push (targets triceps brachii and pectoralis major).
Seated Elastic Band Biceps Curls (targets biceps).
Seated Unilateral Stirrups (targets quadriceps and gluteus maximus).
Seated Hip External Rotation (targets deep external rotators and gluteus maximus).

steps.title: Treatment timing and frequency
steps.instruction: Begin each session 1–2 hours after a meal; alternate upper‑ and lower‑extremity training; each resistance phase lasts 15–30 minutes (plus the 10‑minute warm‑up); conduct sessions every other day for 60 days, then follow participants for an additional 90 days.

steps.title: Sham acupuncture procedure
steps.instruction: In the control group, superficially prick with a 0.30 mm × 40 mm needle at a point 2 cm away from the lateral edge of each true acupoint (non‑meridian site), perform no needle manipulation, retain the needle for 30 minutes, and apply the same exercise therapy and schedule as the acupuncture group.

steps.title: Blood sample collection and storage
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples at the three research centers, transport them to the local laboratory, store at 2–8 °C until processing, label with patient ID codes (no identifiable data), obtain optional consent for future use, store anonymously in a central repository for 5–10 years, then destroy by incineration according to local guidelines.

description: The clinical study corresponding to our protocol is still underway, with subject recruitment and intervention therapy currently in progress. As we have not yet reached the outcome assessment phase, data to validate the protocol have not been generated.
